en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Couple on Grasping (Upādāduka).

Dependent on a non-indicative and non-reactive derived phenomenon (*dhamma*), a non-indicative, non-reactive, and non-derived phenomenon arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-indicative, reactive, and non-derived phenomenon, a non-non-indicative, non-reactive, and non-non-derived phenomenon arises by way of root condition; ... six.
Dependent on a non-indicative, non-reactive, and non-derived phenomenon, a non-non-indicative, non-reactive, and non-non-derived phenomenon arises by way of root condition; ... six.

Dependent on a state that is non-indicative, with resistance, and not derived, and a state that is non-indicative, without resistance, and not derived, there arises a state that is neither indicative nor with resistance and not derived by way of root condition. ... Six. (Abbreviated.
In the root [condition], eighteen; in the predominance [condition], eighteen ... pe ... in the non-disappearance [condition], eighteen.
